top_stories.title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Post Biggest Weekly Inflows in Months
points: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that track Bitcoin's price directly, letting investors buy exposure through a brokerage account) drew $854 million over five consecutive days of net inflows.
Decrypt calls it the largest weekly total since May; Bitcoin Magazine frames it as the biggest since April.
Daily inflow totals shrank as the week progressed, leaving open whether momentum is sustainable.
Buying came during a market dip, suggesting institutions treated price weakness as an entry point.
Elevated rate-hike expectations and high long-dated Treasury yields temper the case that this is a structural turn.

unique_angles.point: A Coldcard hardware wallet exploit may have pushed some holders away from self-custody (holding your own crypto keys) and into regulated ETF products.
BlackRock says ETF holders are maintaining long-term positions rather than panic-selling or trading in and out.

items.title: Standard Chartered's $4T Tokenization Call and 2030 DeFi Targets
points: The bank forecasts $4 trillion in tokenization (converting real-world assets like real estate and securities into blockchain-based digital tokens) by 2030.
It projects 37x growth for DeFi (decentralized finance — peer-to-peer financial services run on blockchains without banks or brokers) protocols.
2030 price targets set for Chainlink ($200), Uniswap, Aave, and Morpho, assuming those protocols capture a material share of the new market.

items.title: OpenAI Pauses Astra Over Cyberweapon Risk
points: OpenAI halted development of its next major model, Astra, citing safety concerns.
The stated fear is the system could autonomously write and deploy cyberweapons without human intervention.
Work resumes only once safeguards catch up to the model's capability level.

items.title: $8M Drained From Crypto Exchange
points: Hackers moved $8 million across the Tron and Ethereum blockchains.
Proceeds were routed through multiple exchanges to obscure the trail.

items.title: Bitcoin 'Anti-Spam' Fork Stalls
points: A Bitcoin fork (a copy of the blockchain running modified rules) aimed at curbing spam transactions halted after mining just two blocks.

headlines: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $854 million in their strongest weekly inflows since May, though analysts debate whether this marks a genuine institutional reversal or temporary relief rally.
A Coldcard hardware wallet exploit may have driven some investors toward Bitcoin ETFs as a safer alternative to self-custody (holding your own crypto keys).
Standard Chartered projects $4 trillion in tokenization (converting real-world assets into blockchain-based digital tokens) by 2030, forecasting major DeFi protocol prices to surge 37x.
OpenAI paused development of its next AI model Astra, citing safety concerns that the system could potentially write its own cyberweapons.
Hackers drained $8 million from a crypto exchange by moving funds across Tron and Ethereum blockchains and routing proceeds through multiple exchanges.

sections.title: Bitcoin ETFs Show Signs of Institutional Comeback
points: 1. Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded five consecutive days of net inflows totaling $854 million last week, the largest weekly total since May.
2. Daily inflow totals declined as the week progressed, signaling uncertainty about whether momentum will sustain.
3. Interest may stem partly from the Coldcard hardware wallet security breach, which prompted some users to shift from self-storage to regulated financial products.
4. Rate-hike expectations remain elevated and long-dated Treasury yields are still high, limiting confidence that this is a structural market turn.

sections.title: Standard Chartered's Ambitious 2030 DeFi Forecast
points: 1. The bank set 2030 price targets for Chainlink ($200), Uniswap, Aave, and Morpho based on predicted 37x growth in decentralized finance (peer-to-peer financial services on blockchain without intermediaries).
2. The bull case rests on an expected $4 trillion volume in tokenization—converting traditional assets like real estate and securities into blockchain tokens.
3. Targets assume that DeFi protocols capture a material share of this massive new market for digital asset issuance and trading.

sections.title: OpenAI Halts Astra Development Over Autonomy Risk
points: 1. OpenAI paused development of its next major AI model Astra due to safety concerns.
2. The company fears the system could be powerful enough to autonomously write and deploy cyberweapons without human intervention.
3. Development will resume only once safeguards catch up to the capability level, indicating a precautionary approach to AI safety.

issues.subject: Bitcoin ETFs See Biggest Inflows Since April 🚀

headlines: Bitcoin spot ETFs (exchange-traded funds tracking Bitcoin's price directly) recorded their largest inflows since April, signaling institutional investor confidence during a market dip.
BlackRock reports that Bitcoin ETF holders are maintaining long-term positions rather than panic-selling, suggesting sustained institutional appetite.
Rising ETF inflows indicate institutional investors are viewing recent price weakness as a buying opportunity.

sections.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflow Surge
points: ETF inflows hit their highest level since April, showing renewed institutional interest after a period of relative outflows.
BlackRock's commentary confirms ETF holders are treating positions as long-term investments, not trading vehicles to be quickly exited.
The timing coincides with a market dip, demonstrating institutional willingness to buy at lower prices rather than exit during weakness.
